![](thumbnail.png)

## Overview

This figure tracks, over time, how concentrated enrollment in each network type — public vs. private higher education — is among higher-income households. Rather than looking at overall access, it applies the Wagstaff concentration index separately to enrollment in each network, allowing the two sectors' income profiles to be compared directly and watched as they evolve.

## Methodology

Time series of the Wagstaff concentration index applied to enrollment by network type (public vs. private), rather than to access overall — measuring whether enrollment in each network is concentrated among higher-income households, and how that concentration has moved over time. Computed directly from PNAD Anual and PNAD Contínua microdata, extracted standalone in this script rather than through the shared harmonized panel.

## Pipeline

Run these scripts in this order, from the project root (each one writes to `data-raw/`, which the next one reads):

1. [`shared-pipeline/pnadc/020_PNAD_Anual_Manual_Import_2001_2015.R`](../../shared-pipeline/pnadc/020_PNAD_Anual_Manual_Import_2001_2015.R) — downloads the raw PNAD Anual 2001–2015 microdata (fixed-width `.txt` + SAS layouts) from the IBGE FTP into `data-raw/pnad_anual_raw/<year>/` — `plot.R` reads these raw files directly
2. [`shared-pipeline/pnadc/000_PNADC_Download_Consolidate.R`](../../shared-pipeline/pnadc/000_PNADC_Download_Consolidate.R) — *(optional)* pre-populates the PNAD Contínua cache in `data-raw/pnadc_raw/`; if you skip it, `plot.R` downloads the years it needs with `PNADcIBGE::get_pnadc()` into the same folder
3. [`plot.R`](plot.R) — reads the raw PNAD Anual files in `data-raw/pnad_anual_raw/` and the PNAD Contínua years in `data-raw/pnadc_raw/`; caches its extraction and bootstrap in `data-raw/rede-publica-privada/` (sources `shared-pipeline/utils/codigos_curso_pnad.R`); writes the figure to `output/figures/wagstaff-rede-publica-privada-timeseries/` — compare it with this post's `thumbnail.png`

## Reproducibility

**Tier: A**

This pipeline uses only public data, accessible via package/API without any credential (PNADcIBGE, censobr, sidrar, ipeadatar). Run the scripts in `shared-pipeline/` in numeric order to reconstruct the intermediate data.
